title: D’Andre Swift, Bears agree to 3-year, $33.75M extension
content:
The Chicago Bears and running back D’Andre Swift have agreed to a three-year contract extension worth up to $33.75 million, Swift’s agency, Athletes First, told The Athletic.

Swift, 27, is entering his third season with the Bears after signing with the franchise as a free agent in March 2024. He was set to enter free agency next offseason, but will instead stick with Chicago.

Swift has topped 1,000 rushing yards in two of his last three seasons, including a Pro Bowl campaign with the Philadelphia Eagles in 2023, and ran for a career-high 1,087 yards last season.

This story will be updated.
